items.title: U.S. gas prices fall below $4 for the first time since July
items.summary: Americans may finally find some relief at the pump. The national average price of regular gasoline fell below $4 a gallon for the first time since July, reaching $3.9788 on Tuesday, according to AAA .

items.title: Polymarket says annualized revenue has topped $1.8 billion
items.summary: Prediction market platform Polymarket has surpassed $1.8 billion in annualized revenue, the company told CNBC on Tuesday.

items.title: Fed Governor Waller sees December hike likely, opens door to possible half-point increase
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said Tuesday the central bank needs to follow through on expectations for additional interest rate hikes or risk its credibility, even suggesting that a larger-than-usual half-percentage-point increase could be warranted in December.

items.title: Jensen Huang exit odds are low on prediction markets after Nvidia probe
items.summary: Nvidia 's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang , citing recent reports that he's been targeted by a "foreign intelligence effort," but traders on prediction markets think it's unlikely he'll be ousted as chief.

items.title: Goldman CEO Solomon says AI financing remains strong despite market jitters
items.summary: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon told CNBC on Monday that financing demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure remains strong despite recent market jitters as investors reassess the risks involving the massive build-out.

items.title: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight
items.summary: Costs for goods and services rose more than expected in October, providing fresh warning signs for the Federal Reserve in its fight to lower inflation.

items.title: China's goods surplus tops $1 trillion for a second year amid calls for Beijing to rebalance trade
items.summary: China's trade surplus topped $1 trillion this year with two months to spare, at a time when partner countries have been raising concerns over Beijing's exports that have been undercutting local industries.

items.title: 3 unexpected reasons the October jobs report was so strong
items.summary: A little-noticed category in Friday's blockbuster jobs report is challenging the consensus view about job losses caused by artificial intelligence.

items.title: A key report for where inflation stood in October comes out Tuesday. Here's what to expect
items.summary: Falling gasoline prices provided some relief to consumers in October, but Federal Reserve officials are increasingly concerned that inflation pressures elsewhere in the economy are proving harder to contain.

items.title: An overzealous Fed is quickly becoming the biggest risk to stocks in 2027
items.summary: ## The Fed remains too sanguine on inflation, and markets too complacent, economist Neil Dutta warns Choose MarketWatch as a preferred source of financial news Investors who are inclined to catastrophize already have plenty of potential pitfalls to fixate on these days.
